name: resume-builder
description: AI-powered resume generator with CLI and Chrome Extension

scripts.typecheck: pnpm -r --filter=./packages/* typecheck && pnpm -r --filter=./apps/* typecheck && pnpm --filter @resume-builder/tests typecheck
scripts.generate:sample: node --import tsx apps/cli/src/index.ts generate --profile ./assets/profile.yaml --job ./assets/jobs/example.txt --template modern --language en --output ./output/sample-modern.pdf --force --provider mock
scripts.generate:sample-ats: node --import tsx apps/cli/src/index.ts generate --profile ./assets/profile.yaml --job ./assets/jobs/example.txt --template ats --language en --output ./output/sample-ats.pdf --force --provider mock
